description: This file defines the ProductSearchSession class which provides utilities for managing product search constraints, options, and executing product searches within a web session context in the OFBiz framework. It includes nested classes for search option state, methods to store, retrieve, and manipulate search options, and functions to build search queries based on user parameters, as well as handling search result pagination.

classes.name: ProductSearchSession.ProductSearchOptions
classes.description: A class that encapsulates search constraint options, sorting, pagination, and related state for product searching within a user session. It provides methods to manipulate and access search option attributes, as well as static methods to manage the search options in HTTP sessions.

methods.name: getProductSearchOptions
methods.description: Retrieve or create the current ProductSearchOptions object from the session.

methods.name: checkSaveSearchOptionsHistory
methods.description: If search options have changed, save the current options into the search history list in session.

methods.name: getSearchOptionsHistoryList
methods.description: Retrieve or initialize the list of previous search options stored in session.

methods.name: clearSearchOptionsHistoryList
methods.description: Remove the search options history list from session.

methods.name: setCurrentSearchFromHistory
methods.description: Set the current search options from a specific index in the history list, optionally removing the old entry.

methods.name: clearSearchOptionsHistoryList
methods.description: Clear the search options history list from session.

methods.name: setCurrentSearchFromHistory
methods.description: Set current search options from a specific index in history, with an option to remove the old.

methods.name: setCurrentSearchFromHistory
methods.description: HTTP request handler to set the current search options from previous history index.

methods.name: checkDoKeywordOverride
methods.description: Checks for any keyword overrides based on product store restrictions and may redirect the response.

methods.name: searchDo
methods.description: Executes the product search based on current search constraints, options, and session state, returning list of product IDs.

methods.name: searchClear
methods.description: Clear all current search options in session.

methods.name: searchGetConstraintStrings
methods.description: Return human-readable strings for current search constraints, optionally detailed.

methods.name: searchGetSortOrderString
methods.description: Return a string representation of the current sort order.

methods.name: searchSetSortOrder
methods.description: Set the sort order for product search.

methods.name: searchAddFeatureIdConstraints
methods.description: Add feature ID constraints to current search constraints collection.

methods.name: searchAddConstraint
methods.description: Add a search constraint to the current session options.

methods.name: searchRemoveConstraint
methods.description: Remove a constraint at a specified index from current constraints list.

methods.name: processSearchParameters
methods.description: Parse incoming request parameters to set search constraints, such as categories, keywords, features, and sorting.

methods.name: getProductSearchResult
methods.description: Constructs and returns search result data including product IDs, total size, and display info based on session search options and constraints.

methods.name: makeSearchParametersString
methods.description: Serialize current search options and constraints into URL parameter string format.

methods.name: listCountByFeatureForType
methods.description: List counts of products grouped by feature ID of a given feature type, considering current search constraints.

methods.name: setCurrentSearchFromHistory
methods.description: HTTP request handler to restore a previous search option state based on history index.
